) BASE ORDER BY BASE.SBJCT_YR DESC , BASE.SBJCT_SMSTR DESC , BASE.ORG_ID , BASE.SBJCT_ID

/* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.lctrPlandocSelect 설 명 : 강의계획서 조회 */ SELECT LCTR_PLANDOC_ID , SBJCT_ID , CRCLMN_OTLN -- 교과목개요 , LCTR_GOAL -- 강의목표 , LCTR_OP_GDLN -- 운영방침 , LCTR_OP_PLAN -- 운영계획 , RLTD_SBJCT_CTS -- 관련과목내용 , REMAKRS -- 참고사항 , PLYR_SHRTCT_KEY_PVSNYN -- 장애인/고령자 지원(플레이어 단축키) , SCRPT_PVSNYN -- 스크립트 제공 , SBTTLS_PVSNYN -- 자막 제공 , PLYR_SPD_ADJST_PVSNYN -- 재생속도조절 제공 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_PLANDOC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.admSbjctSchdlListForPlandocRegist 설 명 : 관리자 강의계획서 등록용 과목일정 주차 목록 */ SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , S.SBJCT_ID , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO AS LCTR_WKNO , CD.CD AS LCTR_WKNO_CD , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNONM AS LCTR_WKNONM , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNONM AS LCTR_WKNO_EXPLN , S.TOC_SEQNO AS LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO , S.SBJCT_SYMD AS LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , S.SBJCT_EYMD AS LCTR_WKNO_EYMD , S.SBJCT_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD AS WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD , S.SBJCT_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD AS WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS LCTR_TYCD , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(2000)) AS LCTR_TTL , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS LCTR_CTS FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_SCHDL S JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_WKNO_CD' AND CD.CD_SEQNO = S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO AND CD.LANG_CD = 'ko' AND CD.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ORDER BY S.TOC_SEQNO, S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.lctrWknoSchdlRegistFromSbjctSchdl 설 명 : 과목일정 주차 기반 강의주차일정 등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL ( LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , SBJCT_ID , LCTR_PLANDOC_ID , LCTR_WKNO , LCTR_WKNO_CD , LCTR_WKNONM , LCTR_WKNO_EXPLN , LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO , LCTR_GOAL , LCTR_CTS , LCTR_OTLN , LCTR_REF_DATA , LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , LCTR_WKNO_EYMD , WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD , WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD , LCTR_TOC_LRN_SCNDS , OYN , DELYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM , LCTR_TYCD , LCTR_TTL , SEQ_LRNYN ) SELECT #{lctrWknoSchdlId} , S.SBJCT_ID , #{lctrPlandocId} , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO , CD.CD , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNONM , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNONM , S.TOC_SEQNO , S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNONM , #{lctrCts} , NULL , NULL , S.SBJCT_SYMD , S.SBJCT_EYMD , S.SBJCT_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD , S.SBJCT_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD , NULL , 'Y' , 'N' , #{rgtrId} , FN_DTTM() , #{mdfrId} , FN_DTTM() , #{lctrTycd} , #{lctrTtl} , 'N' FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_SCHDL S JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_WKNO_CD' AND CD.CD_SEQNO = S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO AND CD.LANG_CD = 'ko' AND CD.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.SBJCT_SCHDL_WKNO = #{lctrWkno}
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.txtbkList 설 명 : 교재 목록 */ SELECT TXTBK.TXTBK_ID , TXTBK.SBJCT_ID , TXTBK.TXTBK_GBNCD , CD.CDNM AS TXTBK_GBNNM , TXTBK.TXTBKNM , TXTBK.ISBN , TXTBK.WRTR , TXTBK.PBLSHR FROM TB_LMS_TXTBK TXTBK LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.UP_CD = 'TXTBK_GBNCD' AND CD.CD = TXTBK.TXTBK_GBNCD AND CD.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE TXTBK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.admLctrPlandocList 설 명 : 관리자 강의계획서 목록 */ SELECT BASE.* FROM (
) BASE ORDER BY BASE.SBJCT_YR DESC, BASE.SBJCT_SMSTR DESC, BASE.ORG_ID, BASE.SBJCT_ID

/* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.rltmExamList 설 명 : 실시간시험 목록 */ SELECT RLTM_EXAM_ID , LCTR_PLANDOC_ID , EXAM_TYCD , RLTM_EXAM_GBNCD , EXAM_QSTNS_DLGTNYN , QSTNS_TRGTR , RLTM_TKEXAM_GBNCD , EXAM_MNTS , MRK_OYN , END_EXAMPPR_OYN , OPEN_OPTN_GBNCD , AUTO_TRNSLTN_PRVNTNYN , VOICE_VDO_INCLDYN , EXAM_OP_AUTH_DLGTNYN FROM TB_LMS_RLTM_EXAM WHERE LCTR_PLANDOC_ID = #{lctrPlandocId} ORDER BY DECODE(RLTM_EXAM_GBNCD, 'EXAM_MID', 1, 'EXAM_LST', 2, 9)

/* SQL ID : LctrPlandocDAO.rltmExamSelect 설 명 : 실시간시험 조회 */ SELECT RLTM_EXAM_ID , LCTR_PLANDOC_ID , RLTM_EXAM_GBNCD FROM TB_LMS_RLTM_EXAM WHERE LCTR_PLANDOC_ID = #{lctrPlandocId} AND RLTM_EXAM_GBNCD = #{rltmExamGbncd}
